==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I see a man dressed like a superhero. He is running with a shield. He looks like he's exercising, rather than chasing after criminals. He spots a celebrity. He tries to quickly change course to talk to the celebrity. He loses his footing and tumbles down the hill. Despite the fall, the man seems to be okay. He and seemingly everyone else swarm the celebrity. I don't recognize the celebrity, but everyone else is clearly obsessed with them.
